messages:
maria: paging — getting customer reports of console errors (~503) starting ~07:02 UTC for eu-west-1. API traces still show successful inference calls. Can someone pick this up?
oncall-bot: INCIDENT_OPENED P0: console-api-divergence (1958000000) — Trigger: alerting/console-5xx-rate > 5% for 3m. Assigned: @maria. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/console-dataplane-diverge :rotating_light:
rahul: taking — joining bridge, grabbing logs. quick question: are the 503s manifesting as frontend static errors or proxy timeouts?
zoe: looks like NGINX 502/504 on console edge in eu-west-1 from customer screenshots. The API service (inference) has normal 200 OKs and low latencies.
elin: I've started a dash correlating requests by trace-id. Early signal: console->console-api sync calls show 504s to control-plane config endpoints. dataplane inference calls don't hit those endpoints.
maria: hypothesis 1: control-plane config propagation issue causing console to fail when fetching route metadata, while dataplane uses pinned model cache so unaffected. Hypothesis 2: edge LB TLS reneg handshake bug for console only.
ops-bot: To help triage: please paste the last 200 lines of console-proxy logs and include trace ids. Use `ops collect-logs --service console-proxy --since 10m`
rahul: pasted logs here (trimmed):
```
[07:02:18] console-proxy ERROR upstream read timeout from 10.12.8.23:504
[07:02:19] console-proxy WARN controlplane cfg fetch failed: GET /v1/configs/route?id=abc timeout
[07:02:24] console-proxy ERROR upstream connection reset by peer
```
zoe: also seeing controlplane/kv-service 429 spikes around the same time in eu-west: `rate_limit_exceeded` from internal KMS/flag service.
elin: adding correlating traces: trace ids: trace-0x9a3, trace-0x9a4 both show console front end waiting on `/v1/configs/route` for ~6s then timeout. Inference traces show no dependency on `/v1/configs/route` for active requests.
maria: immediate mitigation idea: serve a cached config response from console-proxy when control-plane is slow (fallback). Can we enable cfg-cache bypass TTL extension for eu-west temporarily? Consequence: stale route metadata for ~5m. Opinions?
rahul: +1 for cache fallback, low risk and buys time. I'm going to patch the proxy config and roll in eu-west canary to 2 nodes.
oncall-bot: DEPLOY STARTED by rahul: `deploy console-proxy eu-west canary=2` (job 1958000001)
deploy-bot: job 1958000001: rolling to 2 canary instances — expected ~45s per instance. Logs: https://internal.redwood/logs/1958000001
zoe: meanwhile, customer impact: CS reports 38 affected orgs actively using console during window. Severity: degraded for console-only workflows. API-based programmatic traffic unaffected.
elin: adding to timeline: 07:01:50 deploy to control-plane config service (auto-scale event) preceded the spike. Possible correlation: new control-plane instance overwhelmed KMS connections.
maria: rolling mitigation applied — config-cache TTL extended to 5m on canary proxies. Monitoring for 5xx rate drop.
ops-bot: MONITOR UPDATE: console-5xx-rate eu-west-1 dropped from 6.2% to 0.9% within 90s of canary patch.
rahul: can confirm: proxy patch worked on canary. Promoting to full eu-west pool. Running gradual rollout.
zoe: note for RCA: control-plane rate limiting + KMS latency created cascading slowdowns for config reads. Console had a hard dependency on fresh config fetch per page load. Dataplane (inference) uses local pinned config and cache, so it stayed healthy.
elin: captured trace waterfall and CPU/KMS call rates. I'll upload full tracing gist: https://gists.internal/trace-euw-1958 (privileged)
maria: customer comms: drafting status update: "Console in eu-west experienced temporary errors; programmatic API unaffected; mitigation applied; root cause under investigation." Sending to Ops-Support for review. :memo:
ops-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: Customer impact estimate updated: ~38 customers, ~12 orgs with heavy usage, 22% of console user traffic during window.
rahul: post-mitigation note: we saw a flurry of retries from console leading to KMS token refresh storms around 07:01. That likely amplified the control-plane pressure.
zoe: checklist items for RCA thread: 1) KMS connection caps and retry backoff config; 2) control-plane autoscaler surge behaviour; 3) console proxy config fetch semantics (should be async); 4) flag propagation TTLs.
elin: temp mitigation rollback plan: when we confirm KMS/CP fixes, revert cache TTL change to avoid stale routing anomalies. Document TTL change in runbook.
maria: we're handing to eng-sre for RCA drafting. Handoff notes: root cause hypothesis: KMS latency + aggressive console config fetch pattern -> control-plane rate limits -> console timeouts. Dataplane stayed healthy due to different dependency chain.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT_HANDOFF to eng-sre channel at 07:15 UTC (handoff ticket #INC-1958000000).
rahul: assigning RCA owners: myself (control-plane), zoe (console proxy instrumentation), elin (tracing & telemetry). I'll create a timeline doc and attach logs.
maria: final in-thread action items: - confirm KMS backpressure mitigations (rahul) - update console to async config fetch (zoe) - add synthetic check for console config endpoint (elin) - customer follow-up note (maria)
zoe: quick note — add a guard in console that switches to cached routes after 300ms rather than blocking page load. That would significantly reduce blast radius.
elin: uploading timeline + log bundle: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/INC-1958000000/timeline-archive.zip
maria: thanks team. I'll post a short incident summary to #incidents-summary in 30m after RCA draft. Closing on-call here. :white_check_mark:
